intent: Add the phone-operated CI wake lane (PR-S6 of the Sarathi autonomy mission, follow-up to merged PR #1170): .github/workflows/sarathi-wake-lane.yml gives the merged standing wake daemon a DURABLE runtime that the mobile-only operator can dispatch and schedule from a phone, and .github/workflows/sarathi-kill-receipt.yml lets the operator record the Gate-9 kill-path receipt from a phone instead of a shell heredoc on a host he cannot reach. The lane carries the same safety envelope as the daemon: the loop kill-switch guard is the FIRST step (so loop-emergency-stop from the phone halts it, unlike the deliberately unguarded read-only walking-brief), the autonomy dial is the operator-set repository variable DGC_SARATHI_AUTONOMY which defaults to propose when unset (plans and briefs, dispatches nothing), the reversibility gate still runs inside delegate_all before every delegation, and the lane never merges, never labels, and never sets wake_loop_active. Standing-loop continuity (dedup keys, run counter, spend ledger, kill receipt) needs to survive ephemeral runners, so runtime state round-trips through an ORPHAN sarathi-state branch under state/sarathi/** following the loop-control precedent that an emergency/runtime write must not depend on a PR landing; that branch is never merged, so main stays free of runtime receipts. The attestation lane is strictly stronger than the heredoc it replaces: workflow_dispatch only, a typed `verified` confirmation, and mechanical corroboration that GitHub's own run history contains a successful loop-emergency-stop followed by a successful loop-resume, whose run IDs are cited in the receipt's method string. scripts/runtime/sarathi_proof_window.py is NOT modified and still never writes the receipt; a regression test pins that contract so this PR cannot be read as weakening Gate 9. Surface-ownership check at e1c5dff: both workflow files are new names, and while the merge-master-mike track owns automerge.yml, codex-mention-router.yml and merge-master-mike-backlog.yml by name and the titanium track owns hermetic/tests/ci-parity/docops/pr-dedupe/bot-pr-limit/a2a-agni-live-contact by name, neither track claims .github/workflows/** as a wildcard, so no owned surface is touched.

gates.name: sarathi-regression
gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_sarathi_wake_daemon.py tests/test_sarathi_proof_window.py tests/test_sarathi_wake.py tests/test_sarathi_delegate.py tests/test_sarathi_plan.py tests/test_sarathi_proof.py

commit.message: feat(sarathi): PR-S6 phone-operated CI wake lane + kill-path attestation

interface_mismatches: The merged daemon assumes a host process re-invokes it per cadence (its own packet listed 'a truly continuous standing loop is the operator's scheduler' as an honest blocker). The operator is mobile-only and walking Japan, so no such host exists; this lane supplies GitHub Actions as that host and makes the cadence a cron plus a phone-tappable workflow_dispatch.

The daemon's dedup, run counter and spend ledger are per-state-root and assume durable storage, but Actions runners are ephemeral, which would make every scheduled run re-dispatch the same unchanged backlog item. The orphan sarathi-state branch supplies the missing durability; verified locally by simulating the restore/persist round trip against a bare repo (two runs, both briefs retained, orphan branch isolated from main history).

Gate 9 requires a kill-path receipt the runner may never create, but the documented way to create it was a shell heredoc on the runtime host. The attestation lane resolves that for a mobile operator without touching the runner's contract.
honest_blockers: This lane does not close item F: at full the daemon still only enqueues a mailbox merge-intent, and nothing yet converts that into the automerge label Merge Master Mike consumes, so the DoD's zero-touch auto-merge remains unreached.

Mike's unattended lane is still unarmed: 'Automerge tier policy' is absent from scripts/governance/ci_parity_manifest.json required_contexts (verified at e1c5dff) and therefore almost certainly absent from branch protection, and the MIKE_PAT Actions write scope cannot be verified from a container.
--cap-usd still bounds only daemon-direct spend (item G); the lane inherits that honest limit and the report keeps labelling it budget_scope daemon-direct-spend.

The lane's shell was exercised against a simulated bare repo, not against GitHub; first live dispatch is the real proof and the operator should run it in daemon mode at the default propose dial before scheduling anything.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the two workflow files, the test and this packet together, then delete the sarathi-state branch. Nothing on main reads the lane, no runtime state lives on main, and the merged daemon and proof runner are untouched.
